summary.text: Captain of Meges' Dulichian contingent in the battle at the ships — distinct from Araphius son of Merops of Percote and from the Elis captains of the Catalogue.

story.text: When the fight raged where the wall was lowest, the Epeians were led by Meges son of Phyleus, and Araphion and Dracius followed in the press of battle among the stout-hearted warriors.
